rows.jyutping: A ge3 hung1 hei3 m4 lau4 tung1
rows.note: Use this construction for a room or enclosed place that feels stuffy; Cantonese normally describes the air rather than naming the stuffiness.

example.english: The stuffiness in this room makes it uncomfortable to sit here for long.
example.traditional: 呢間房嘅空氣唔流通，坐耐咗好辛苦。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong4 ge3 hung1 hei3 m4 lau4 tung1 zo6 noi6 zo2 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an angry, stubborn temperament.

example.english: When my boss shows his stuffiness, the whole office goes quiet.
example.traditional: 我老闆一發牛脾氣，成間房都靜晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lou5 baan2 jat1 faat3 ngau4 pei4 hei3 seng4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 zing6 saai3
